chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Fadhl from Yunus ibn Ya'qub who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): From where should I enter Mecca, having come from Medina? He said: 'Enter from the upper part of Mecca, and when you leave intending to go to Medina, exit from the lower part of Mecca.'
And it is recommended that he perform a ritual bath before entering Mecca; that was narrated.

key_terms.أَسْفَلِ مَكَّةَ: The lower part of Mecca (exit point)
key_terms.أَعْلَى مَكَّةَ: The upper part of Mecca (entry point)
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: It is recommended (preferred but not obligatory)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended route for entering and exiting Mecca when traveling from Medina?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) provides specific guidance on entering and exiting Mecca from the 'upper' and 'lower' gates respectively, a practice rooted in the traditions of the Prophet and the Imams to honor the city's sanctity. This narration also highlights the spiritual preparation of performing ghusl before entry, emphasizing the transition from the mundane to the sacred space. In Shia jurisprudence, these details reflect the emphasis on adab (etiquette) and physical purity as integral components of pilgrimage rituals.
